links.outcome: LLM correctness on peripheral IV catheter infection prevention guideline questions
links.effect: GPT-3.5 and GPT-4o scored 5/10, GPT-4 scored 3/10; struggled with hand hygiene, aseptic technique, and dressing type. Accuracy averaged 3.9, 3.5, 3.4.
links.quote: GPT-3.5 and GPT-4o each scored 5 out of 10 on the Information Form for Preventing Peripheral Venous Catheter-Related Infections, while GPT-4 scored 3 out of 10.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT information on infection prevention, implying need for verification
links.effect: Accuracy averaged 3.9 (GPT-3.5), 3.5 (GPT-4), 3.4 (GPT-4o); completeness 1.8, 1.6, 1.8; no significant differences between models (p > 0.05).
links.quote: The findings highlight that although ChatGPT models can provide supportive information, their limitations in accuracy and completeness may pose risks for patient safety, particularly in critical domains such as aseptic technique and hand hygiene.

screen.reason: Evaluated the accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o) on answering a 10-question multiple-choice questionnaire about preventing peripheral venous catheter-related infections without testing a deployment practice.
